reviewer: Claude Code adversarial review agents, eight independent passes (2026-11-18 to 2026-11-19)

finding_summary.note: All eight passes reviewed the code and the release account. No pass found a defect in the shipped code; every surviving finding is in prose.

evidence_outside_this_review.note: The suite runs separately from the review; no review pass re-ran it.

surviving_findings.claim: The transfer.py row says model-specific repairs and domain heuristics go provisional and 'everything else is carried'. On a split-only change DOMAIN_HEURISTIC is carried and MODEL_SPECIFIC_REPAIR is carried; the row's universal is false against tests/test_sim_transfer.py.
'now stamps each observation with its sample_index' is true only for the calibration measurement (light_gate.py:288); the run-path OBSERVED append (light_gate.py:433) writes no sample_index.
The same sample_index universal, repeated a third time.

'A hand-edited ledger line fails to load rather than being silently trusted' is not enforced for values inside the accepted domain: Observation.from_dict coerces regressions through str(), so an in-domain hand edit loads.
'SIM reads no artifact that records the model' is false as written: every AttemptRecord carries SettingFingerprint.model_id in its own ledger.
'No runtime turn yet persists which model ran it' is false: python/synapse/panel/claude_worker.py:330 writes model into the per-turn usage ledger.
'the release suite is the evidence that nothing else changed' is false as an evidence claim: the gate collects tests/ only, while the release diff changes 30 files.
'The commits after 413aefb3 carry the later reviews' fixes' is a closure claim the tree does not support while the findings above stand.
'Fixed in this commit' and 'Corrected here' read as the carrying commit; the co-adoption fix is e277f802.
'two blockers, thirteen material findings' are counts not bound to a committed review record.

owner_direction.decision: Release v5.103.0 with the open prose findings disclosed. The owner directed the release after eight adversarial reviews, none of which found a defect in the shipped code, and after five fenced stock-suite runs at 13,057 passed / 0 failed / 727 skipped.
owner_direction.verbatim_scope: Direct the v5.103.0 release with the open prose findings disclosed: write harness/notes/release-5.103.0/CRUX-RECORD.json recording eight failed reviews and the surviving findings, commit it on f1a03901, push to master behind Gate C, take CI green, and tag v5.103.0 without publishing.

gate_note: scripts/tag_release.py requires passed=true and therefore refuses this record by design; the tag for this release is created under the owner's direction above, and this file is the disclosure that the gate's condition was not met. A reader should treat v5.103.0 as a release whose code passed every check available and whose documentation carries the eleven findings listed here.
